### Accessibility and Performance Checklist

Before closing this room issue, verify:

- [ ] axe-core zero violations at 1440px on the room index
- [ ] axe-core zero violations at 390px on the room index
- [ ] axe-core zero violations at 1440px on one article page
- [ ] axe-core zero violations at 390px on one article page
- [ ] Color is never the only signal (e.g. Mercati up and down numbers carry a sign and arrow)
- [ ] Reduced motion removes movement
- [ ] Sound is off by default
- [ ] Keyboard path works with visible focus through the menu, room, and article
- [ ] Under 1 MB transferred on first load with sound off
- [ ] No layout shift from textures or fonts
